changelog:
Initial release of pricing-strategist skill

- Provides structured workflow for pricing strategy including user willingness research, competitor analysis, pricing model, and monetization planning.
- Outputs pricing strategy documents in standardized Markdown format.
- Requires competitor pricing comparison (at least 3 competitors) and clear free tier limitations.
- Ensures key pricing assumptions are explicitly highlighted for validation.
